FILE fpga_v8_migration/cooperative_host/README.md
40: | `KnownRejected` | Definite rejection; requested ownership side effect did not occur | CLAIM stays Idle/Busy; ACK stays Owned/Rejected for explicit retry |
41: | `DeliveryKnownUnknownResponse` | Complete ordered transaction retired, but response code unavailable | Verify bound descriptor/STATUS and staged words; never label delivery as AXI OKAY |
42: | `Uncertain` | Partial, timeout, lost completion, or possibly outstanding work | Faulted; no retry or ACK |
46: `DeliveryKnownUnknownResponse`. If completion itself is unknown, it must report
47: `Uncertain`. A read with unknown RRESP still needs a complete, stable 16-byte
66:   exact configured addresses; programmable runtime maps require external proof.
67: - Already reserve all read16/write16 transport scratch buffers and a separate,
74: - Confirm a coordinated common reset and supply a fresh **nonzero**
75:   `Config::expected_generation`. The helper never chooses an epoch from time,
77:   manager must exclude old ACKs across reset/rollover and prevent identity reuse.
79:   unique source sequences within the generation. Multi-camera sequence collisions
83:   is not required to equal `(generation << 32) | sequence`.
85: The header implements **no** allocation of driver buffers, open, ioctl, mmap,
86: device writes, sleeps, bus cancellation or reset. `copy_ddr_blocking` uses the
92: drain/reset, so returning or destroying an error vector cannot cause a dangling
122: `{bank,sequence,generation,length,address,camera,source_bank,source_address,token}`.
123: It checks expected generation, nonzero sequence/token, both banks <=1, camera 4,
124: exact length/addresses and physical ranges. It rereads bank/sequence/generation
125: and STATUS before entering Claimed to reject reset-mixed metadata.
132: caller vector returns InvalidBuffer, retains Claimed, and performs no DMA.
135: generation in three individual beats, reads each staged value, verifies the
137: Owned and permits a later **explicit** call to restage/retry. Uncertain delivery
155: uncertain reads/writes, transport exceptions, truncated/error DMA, changed lease
158: `snapshot()` reports the state, first fault, requested bank, possible claim,
161: There is no destructor ACK, fake source release, local reset, or catch-and-release
164: Drain outstanding bus/DMA work or perform an externally coordinated common reset
166: fresh generation/reservation. Old host operations must not survive that reset.
184: explicit rejected-ACK retry, uncertain writes without retry, descriptor freeze

FILE fpga_v8_migration/driver_ownership_audit/README.md
17: The fixed loaded-build disassembly confirms the relevant global behavior: `pango_cdev_open` clears the global state counters; `pango_cdev_release` frees both global coherent buffers and clears their pointers; `pango_cdev_mmap` checks requested size against global allocation sizes and calls coherent mapping; `pango_irq_handler0/1/2` share one atomic DMA state and queue camera/NPU work. Exact output is in `003_pango_pci_driver_fixed_20260926_disassembly.txt`; ELF metadata/source breadcrumbs are in `board_evidence.json`.
21: In retained source, `dma_info.addr_r` and `dma_info.addr_w`, allocation sizes, `dma_operation`, MSI counters, DMA state, camera/NPU queues, and completion counters are global (`pango_pci_driver.h:231-275`, `pango_pci_driver.c:35-44,364-366`). The map command rejects an already allocated TX or RX global buffer with `-EBUSY` (`pango_pci_driver.c:462-512`); no `-EEXIST` path exists in the retained or migration sources. Existing host code maps two 4 MiB windows (`project/host/detview/pango_dev.h:30-40`). Thus the currently live viewer already occupies the global allocation/mapping namespace; another 4 MiB pair cannot be reserved concurrently through this ABI.
23: `release` unconditionally frees whichever global buffers exist (`pango_pci_driver.c:998-1010`), regardless of which file allocated them. `open` resets global completion and queue state (`979-995`). This means a benchmark cannot safely overlap the viewer, and all current users must be quiesced at a documented boundary before any reservation attempt. Mappings observed in `/proc/<pid>/maps` prove mappings only; they do not prove allocator ownership or safe reuse.
33: 1. Establish a quiesced boundary where every current `/dev/pango_pci_driver` fd is closed and no DMA/camera/NPU operation can be pending; the present viewer must be included because it owns the sole observed fd and two 4 MiB mappings.
35: 3. Serialize all DMA submissions and completion waits through one backend owner. Treat timeout as a quarantine condition until hardware idle/completion is independently established; do not reuse or free buffers after an ambiguous timeout.
36: 4. Add checked arithmetic for `offset_addr + total_length` against the allocated side and a defined policy for camera/NPU queued work before benchmark ownership begins.
38: Unproven and requiring a later authorized validation: whether the fixed binary\xe2\x80\x99s source is exactly retained or the fixed migration source; whether the H2F MSI retirement RTL fix is present in the loaded FPGA bitstream; and whether an actual quiesced benchmark window can be obtained from all users. The H2F MSI retirement issue remains a separate RTL-agent item.

FILE fpga_v8_migration/pcie_retirement_contract/README.md
32: wrapper's module name **inside the simulation library only**. Never register
46: coordinated reset with a pending response, large streaming transfers, partial
64: Reset of the retirement handshake is an epoch change and requires coordinated
65: reset of the PCIe/controller/FIFO and AXI fabric/endpoint. A CPU-only restart,
66: an independent PCIe link reset or an independently reset endpoint is not a
68: actual pending transaction is retired or the coordinated reset is complete.
71: the appropriate host classification is `DeliveryKnownUnknownResponse`;
82: host memory visibility are outside this simulation. FPGA-to-host completion

FILE fpga_v8_migration/pcie_retirement_contract/REPORT.md
4: ioctl driven by that MSI cannot justify `DeliveryKnownUnknownResponse` for H2F
6: coordinated reset, but is **not a general transport acceptance**: inherited W
45: FIFO-side `BVALID && BREADY`, not internal local AXI-Lite completion.
73: generation setup, matching ACK, rejected CLAIM, rejected ACK, full AW stall,
74: local AW/W stalls and a post-reset transfer. Each command produces exactly
104:   out in the W state. Candidate times out without MSI. A coordinated reset
108:   without MSI, then recovers only through coordinated reset.
109: - **Pending final B reset:** the candidate produces no MSI for the abandoned
110:   transaction, clears both handshake domains, and cannot reuse that epoch's
138: and exact parameter/port equality. New handshake resets assert in both clock
139: domains and release through two local clock flops. Its OR-combined epoch reset
140: does **not** solve an independently reset legacy AXI transaction: the entire
142: `top.v:398` derives AXI reset from DDR initialization separately from PCIe
143: reset. A CPU restart or independent PCIe reset cannot be accepted as recovery.
146: candidate MSI can qualify as `DeliveryKnownUnknownResponse`. A register
157: validation remain outside this regression.

FILE fpga_v8_migration/whole_candidate_v2_route_01/inputs/ipcore/pcie_test/rtl/hsst_pipe/hsst_rst_cross_sync_v1_0.v
6: module  hsst_rst_cross_sync_v1_0 #(
7:     parameter RST_CNTR_WIDTH     = 16,
8:     parameter RST_CNTR_VALUE     = 16'hC000
10:     // Reset and Clock
12:     input           rstn_in,
14:     output  reg     rstn_out
23:     wire                          rstn_inner;
24:     reg     [3:0]                 rstn_inner_d;
25:     reg                           rstn_sync;
26:     reg     [RST_CNTR_WIDTH-1:0]  cnt_rst;
31:     always@(posedge clk or negedge rstn_in) 
33:         if(!rstn_in) 
46:     assign rstn_inner = rs2;
50:             rstn_inner_d = 4'hf; //CLM reg default value is 1
51:             rstn_sync    = 1'b1;
52:             cnt_rst      = {RST_CNTR_WIDTH{1'b1}};
53:             rstn_out     = 1'b1;
57:     always @(posedge clk or negedge rstn_inner)
59:         if (!rstn_inner) begin
60:             rstn_inner_d <= 4'h0; //CLM reg default value is 1
61:             rstn_sync    <= 1'b0;
62:             cnt_rst      <= {RST_CNTR_WIDTH{1'b1}};
63:             rstn_out     <= 1'b0;
66:             rstn_inner_d <= {rstn_inner_d[2:0], rstn_inner};
68:             if (rstn_inner_d[3:2] == 2'd0)
69:                 rstn_sync <= 1'b0;
71:                 rstn_sync <= 1'b1;
73:             if (~rstn_sync) begin
74:                 cnt_rst <= {RST_CNTR_WIDTH{1'b1}};
75:                 rstn_out   <= 1'b0;
77:             else if (cnt_rst == RST_CNTR_VALUE)
78:                 rstn_out <= 1'b1;
80:                 rstn_out <= 1'b0;
81:                 cnt_rst <= cnt_rst + {{(RST_CNTR_WIDTH-1){1'b0}}, 1'b1};
